verdict.rationale: Ardent's CLI can print a 'pooled' connection URL for a branch alongside direct and prisma URLs. That implies the product provides built-in pooled endpoints, so no self-operated pgbouncer is needed. Nothing describes the pooler's behavior, limits, or concurrency capacity. missing for 10: documentation of the pooler itself (mode, configuration), evidence of handling thousands of concurrent connections, connection limits per branch, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, a built-in connection pooler handles thousands of concurrent connections without me operating my own pgbouncer or proxy

citations.quote: --url-type <type> | Which URL to print: direct (default), pooled, or prisma
